description: Header file for MemIf module in AUTOSAR platform, defining interfaces, macros, and conditional includes for memory interface functionalities.

methods.name: MemIf_SetMode
methods.description: Sets the memory interface mode, implementation varies based on device configuration.

methods.name: MemIf_Read
methods.description: Reads data from specified memory device and block.

methods.name: MemIf_Write
methods.description: Writes data to specified memory device and block.

methods.name: MemIf_Cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing memory operation on specified device.

methods.name: MemIf_GetStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of the specified memory device.

methods.name: MemIf_GetJobResult
methods.description: Gets the result of the last job on the specified device.

methods.name: MemIf_InvalidateBlock
methods.description: Invalidates a memory block on the specified device.

methods.name: MemIf_EraseImmediateBlock
methods.description: Immediately erases a memory block on the specified device.
